thought.text: The spring-app container's health endpoint returns 200. Let me verify the API through the proxy with a real endpoint.

reasoning_content: Spring app health at 8081 returns 200 which is the healthcheck. The API root via proxy returns 404 for /health but the backend is healthy per docker. Let me check a real API endpoint, e.g., swagger-ui or /v1/.

action.command: for p in /swagger-ui /v3/api-docs /swagger-ui/index.html; do echo -n "$p => "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" "http://127.0.0.1$p"; done; echo "=== api-docs content head ==="; curl -s -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1/v3/api-docs | head -c 200
